nomenclature.etymology_html:
- Coffea: For the species of coffee plant
- wightiana: For Robert Wight (1796-1872), English botanist

stem_bark.text: The bark of Coffea wightiana is straight with tiny spines in branches and branchlets. The stem of Coffea wightiana is straight with tiny spines in branches and branchlets.
stem_bark.text_html:
The bark of Coffea wightiana is straight with tiny spines in branches and branchlets. 
The stem of Coffea wightiana is straight with tiny spines in branches and branchlets.

seed.text: The seeds of Coffea wightiana are embedded in a gelatinous membrane in the fruit. There is usually 2 spherical seeds in each fruit.
seed.text_html:
The seeds of Coffea wightiana are embedded in a gelatinous membrane in the fruit. 
There is usually 2 spherical seeds in each fruit.

images.caption: Coffea wightiana dissected fruit with seeds inside and washed seeds (right)
Coffea wightiana washed seeds

fruit.text: The fruit of Coffea wightiana is a berry. Its colour is purple when ripe. The size of the fruit is less than 1 cm.
fruit.text_html:
The fruit of Coffea wightiana is a berry. 
Its colour is purple when ripe. 
The size of the fruit is less than 1 cm.

images.caption: Coffea wightiana unripe fruits on the plant

Coffea wightiana mature fruits

flower.text: The flower of Coffea wightiana is white. The flower size is around 2 cm. The flowers appear as solitary or in cymes, the bracteoles forming a calyculus and the calyx appearing irregularly and many toothed. Each flower has 5 to 7 petals, which can be round or sharp. The flower has a mild aroma.
flower.text_html:
The flower of Coffea wightiana is white. 
The flower size is around 2 cm. 
The flowers appear as solitary or in cymes, the bracteoles forming a calyculus and the calyx appearing irregularly and many toothed. Each flower has 5 to 7 petals, which can be round or sharp.
The flower has a mild aroma.

leaf.text: The leaves of Coffea wightiana are simple and in opposite arrangement. The length of the leaflet is 3 cm and the width is 1.5 cm. The shape of the leaves is elliptic-ovate, apex obtuse, membranous, with a broad stipule.
leaf.text_html:
The leaves of Coffea wightiana are simple and in opposite arrangement. 
The length of the leaflet is 3 cm and the width is 1.5 cm. 
The shape of the leaves is elliptic-ovate, apex obtuse, membranous, with a broad stipule.

habit.text: Coffea wightiana is a small deciduous shrub, growing up to 3 m high. It is usually found in the open or as a component of the understory in a mature forest.
habit.text_html:
Coffea wightiana is a small deciduous shrub, growing up to 3 m high.  
It is usually found in the open or as a component of the understory in a mature forest.
